blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) on Wednesday said it will continue to conduct protests even after US President Donald Trump has left the country, this time to hold President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. held accountable for wasting public funds. “The protests will continue even if Trump is gone, because we will make sure that Marcos will be held accountable for squandering P22 billion for his [Association of Southeast Asian Nations] summit and welcome [honors] for Trump,” said Bayan secretary general Mong Palatino. Palatino made the statement during an ambush interview on the sidelines of a protest held on Wednesday morning […]... Keep on reading: Bayan: Rallies to continue despite Trump’s departure from PH
